messages:
Ava: Quick pulse — post-webinar metrics look messy. CTR on the blog spike +32% but SQL leads flat. wondering if UTM stacking is double-counting webinar traffic :thinking_face:
Diego: saw that too. i pulled raw events — lots of 'utm_campaign=mar-apr-webinar' + 'ref=webinar-host' combos. could be our GA->CRM dedupe failing
Priya: can someone drop the query we use to dedupe leads? i want to compare against registration list
Marta: here's the rough dedupe we run nightly: ```sql
SELECT email, MIN(created_at) as first_seen FROM leads GROUP BY email;```
Marta: that's the issue — first_seen logic keeps the earliest touch which is often from the blog, not the webinar registration. we need to prefer webinar_reg_id when present
Liam: +1. suggest change to: ```sql
SELECT coalesce(webinar_reg_id, email) as id, MIN(created_at) as first_seen FROM leads GROUP BY 1;```
Diego: also there's a known routing rule flip last week where inbound rule #7 (utm routing) was disabled for 3 hours. ops-bot shows it happened around 2028-03-12 14:05 UTC
ops-bot: Routing rule #7 toggled OFF by deploy-service (rollout: marketing/filters) — incident ticket MC-482 queued
Ava: timeline fits — webinar ran at 14:10 UTC. so a chunk of registrations may have been ingested without the proper tag and land in 'organic' bucket
Priya: can analytics remap those leads by matching emails to registration export? we should run a backfill to correct source and recalc attribution in the dashboard
Diego: i'll export reg list and run a join. heads up: around ~1.2k rows, some emails fuzzy (Gmail variants). I'll normalise before join
Marta: also recommend we add a short-term dashboard filter: exclude leads created during 14:00-14:20 UTC and re-run the KPI snapshot to see impact
Liam: low-effort calc: roll up leads by source before/after correction and compare MQL conversion. i can sketch in Looker quick
Ava: thanks team. action items: 1) Diego — export + fuzzy join and create mapping (due EOD). 2) Priya — coordinate backfill plan with ops (due tomorrow morning). 3) Liam — temporary dashboard variant showing corrected vs raw (due EOD). 4) Marta — PR to change dedupe SQL to prefer webinar_reg_id (security review ok?).
Priya: noted. will open MC-489 for backfill with a short rollback plan
Diego: exported file to /mnt/marketing/exports/webinar_03_12.csv and started normalisation. leaving notes in the CSV header. ping me if you need direct access
Ava: perfect. once we have corrected attribution let's re-run the weekly KPI email and call out the bias in the 'webinar conversion' narrative so leadership doesn't misinterpret
Liam: one more ask — can we add a small note in the dashboard explaining the temporary routing outage and the data correction window? saves conf calls later :pray:
Ava: agreed. we'll annotate. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
